summary: W57 joins each continuously registered native thread to a distinct busy block backing the linked executable's TLS. Own-image anchors are copied under the registry lock, the default heap is walked without that lock, and a registry change invalidates the whole observation. The data extent already includes the PE TLS template. The report separates its excess data, per-entry heap overhead and the process thread count outside this cohort. The Release fixture cross-checks four block lengths with HeapSize, including the unregistered peer and a 64-byte-aligned TLS cell. It verifies retirement after join, rejects two anchors in one block and rejects reused cohort counts. All 46 Release regression groups and the scoped native startup pass.
